text: Assumption: "Bit 7 and Bit 8" refers to the two most significant bits — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: "Bit 7 and Bit 8" refers to the two most significant bits — is this correct?
norm: bit 7 and bit 8 refers to the two most significant bits
assumption: "Bit 7 and Bit 8" refers to the two most significant bits.
rationale: It complements the 6 least significant bits ("6 least specific bits") to form a complete 8-bit type (uint8).

original.text: Annahme: Mit „Bit 7 and Bit 8“ dürften die beiden höchstwertigen Bits gemeint sein — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Mit „Bit 7 and Bit 8“ dürften die beiden höchstwertigen Bits gemeint sein
original.rationale: Ergänzt die 6 niederwertigen Bits („6 least specific bits“) zu einem vollständigen 8-Bit-Typ (uint8).
